## Claim Verification Details & Empirical Evidence

### 1. Hash-Chained Audit Log
- **Claim Description:** Append-only, cryptographic SHA-256 hash chaining over every state-changing event; PostgreSQL trigger and role revocation prevent update/delete/truncate; verify_chain walks and confirms chain integrity.
- **Implementation Path:** [`backend/app/services/audit/service.py, backend/app/db/models.py`](../backend/app/services/audit/service.py)
- **Verification Test:** [`backend/tests/integration/test_audit_tamper_isolated.py, backend/tests/integration/test_audit.py`](../backend/tests/integration/test_audit_tamper_isolated.py)
- **Measurement / Benchmark:** `docs/threat_model.md`
- **Audit Evidence:** verify_chain() validates genesis to tip; isolated database test confirms single-row tampering breaks chain and identifies row; GET /api/v1/audit/verify endpoint live in cockpit.
- **Status:** **VERIFIED**

### 2. Income Reconciliation
- **Claim Description:** Cross-checks bank account credit inflows against declared gig-platform earnings report within temporal window; penalises mismatch in scorecard.
- **Implementation Path:** [`backend/app/services/scoring/features.py, backend/app/config/scorecard_v1.yaml`](../backend/app/services/scoring/features.py)
- **Verification Test:** [`backend/tests/unit/test_features.py, backend/tests/unit/test_fraud_semantic_checks.py`](../backend/tests/unit/test_features.py)
- **Measurement / Benchmark:** `docs/fraud_eval.md`
- **Audit Evidence:** GIG_PAYOUT vs BANK_STATEMENT reconciliation achieves 100% recall on tampered inflows; tested on exact matches, partial matches, and absent bank records.
- **Status:** **VERIFIED**

### 3. Grounding Verifier
- **Claim Description:** Zero/low-temperature summary generator checked by regex token extractor against computed values JSON; rejects hallucinated numeric values or PII tokens and falls back to deterministic template.
- **Implementation Path:** [`backend/app/services/explain/grounding.py, backend/app/services/explain/summary.py`](../backend/app/services/explain/grounding.py)
- **Verification Test:** [`backend/tests/unit/test_summary.py`](../backend/tests/unit/test_summary.py)
- **Measurement / Benchmark:** `docs/model_card.md`
- **Audit Evidence:** 100% of numeric tokens verified within ±2% relative / ±₹1.00 tolerance; prohibited demographic words unconditionally flagged; fallback to deterministic template validated.
- **Status:** **VERIFIED**

### 4. Prompt-Injection Defense
- **Claim Description:** Document content treated as untrusted pixel data; multi-layer defense (regex pattern scanning, schema range constraints, vision model instruction flag, confidence penalty) caps outcome at REFER (RC07).
- **Implementation Path:** [`backend/app/services/extraction/guardrails.py, backend/app/services/scoring/decision.py`](../backend/app/services/extraction/guardrails.py)
- **Verification Test:** [`backend/tests/unit/test_injection_defense.py, backend/tests/unit/test_extraction_guardrails.py`](../backend/tests/unit/test_injection_defense.py)
- **Measurement / Benchmark:** `docs/injection_eval.md`
- **Audit Evidence:** 6/6 adversarial documents (visible, low-contrast, in-field) detected; 0 scorecard numeric distortions (delta = 0.0); 100% capped at REFER with RC07.
- **Status:** **VERIFIED**

### 5. Two-Signal Decision (Scorecard + pgvector Precedents)
- **Claim Description:** Additive 7-factor scorecard combined with 10-dimensional pgvector cosine-similarity peer lookup (k=35); peer default-rate Wilson 95% CI overrides false approvals (blind-spots) and false declines (resilient).
- **Implementation Path:** [`backend/app/services/scoring/decision.py, backend/app/services/vectors/precedents.py, backend/app/config/policy_v1.yaml`](../backend/app/services/scoring/decision.py)
- **Verification Test:** [`backend/tests/unit/test_two_signal.py, backend/tests/integration/test_pipeline_full.py`](../backend/tests/unit/test_two_signal.py)
- **Measurement / Benchmark:** `docs/two_signal_eval.md`
- **Audit Evidence:** On held-out TEST split (n=418), approved portfolio default rate drops from 14.3% to 7.8% (-6.5pp); catches 68.8% of blind-spot defaults; recovers 82.8% of resilient non-defaulters.
- **Status:** **VERIFIED**

### 6. Fraud Evaluation with Hard Negatives
- **Claim Description:** Multi-modal forensic screening: Error Level Analysis (ELA) + noise-residual block variance, plus perceptual hash (pHash 256-bit) Hamming distance database matching with corroboration gate.
- **Implementation Path:** [`backend/app/services/fraud/tamper_radar.py, backend/app/services/fraud/phash.py, backend/app/services/fraud/service.py`](../backend/app/services/fraud/tamper_radar.py)
- **Verification Test:** [`backend/tests/integration/test_fraud_service.py, backend/tests/unit/test_fraud_imaging.py, backend/tests/integration/test_fraud_phash.py`](../backend/tests/integration/test_fraud_service.py)
- **Measurement / Benchmark:** `docs/fraud_eval.md`
- **Audit Evidence:** Tamper Radar achieves Precision=0.64, Recall=0.90, F1=0.75 on TEST split at MEDIUM threshold; pHash T=6 yields 0.00% FPR on hard negatives and catches P05/P06 syndicate collision live.
- **Status:** **VERIFIED**

### 7. Human-in-the-Loop Override
- **Claim Description:** Underwriter can override automated decision with mandatory audit trail; requires >=5 character justification, records previous outcome, new outcome, and underwriter identity in immutable hash chain.
- **Implementation Path:** [`backend/app/api/v1/applications.py, backend/app/services/audit/service.py`](../backend/app/api/v1/applications.py)
- **Verification Test:** [`backend/tests/integration/test_pipeline_full.py, backend/tests/unit/test_decision.py`](../backend/tests/integration/test_pipeline_full.py)
- **Measurement / Benchmark:** `docs/model_card.md`
- **Audit Evidence:** Override endpoint rejects short reasons, updates final_outcome, preserves original scorecard evaluation, and appends DECISION_OVERRIDDEN event verified by chain check.
- **Status:** **VERIFIED**

### 8. Completeness & Extraction Confidence Gating
- **Claim Description:** Applications with missing required documents or low extraction confidence (<0.55) are capped at REFER (RC09), ensuring the engine never issues an automatic DECLINE on thin data alone.
- **Implementation Path:** [`backend/app/services/scoring/decision.py, backend/app/config/policy_v1.yaml`](../backend/app/services/scoring/decision.py)
- **Verification Test:** [`backend/tests/unit/test_decision.py, backend/tests/unit/test_extraction_self_consistency.py`](../backend/tests/unit/test_decision.py)
- **Measurement / Benchmark:** `docs/validation_report.md, docs/extraction_eval.md`
- **Audit Evidence:** Applications with data completeness < 0.55 or min extraction confidence < 0.55 cap at REFER with reason code RC09; persona P08 (thin file bank-only) verified in integration test.
- **Status:** **VERIFIED**

### 9. Responsible AI: Sanitizer Invariance, Monotonicity & Fairness
- **Claim Description:** Strict fail-closed allowlist sanitizer prevents PII or proxy leakage into scoring; Hypothesis property tests guarantee invariance under demographic perturbation and monotonicity; four-fifths rule fairness audit.
- **Implementation Path:** [`backend/app/services/guardrails/sanitizer.py, backend/app/services/scoring/scorecard.py`](../backend/app/services/guardrails/sanitizer.py)
- **Verification Test:** [`backend/tests/unit/test_scoring_properties.py, backend/tests/unit/test_fairness_proxy_rejection.py`](../backend/tests/unit/test_scoring_properties.py)
- **Measurement / Benchmark:** `docs/fairness_report.md, docs/model_card.md`
- **Audit Evidence:** 200 randomized applicant profiles confirm 100% invariance of score and decision to name, phone, address, gender, and vocation; adverse-impact ratio AIR=0.884 (PASS >=0.80); proxy feature injection dropped unconditionally.
- **Status:** **VERIFIED**

### 10. Server-Side Consent Enforcement & Data Erasure Retention
- **Claim Description:** Versioned markdown consent policy served with SHA-256 hash; API rejects submissions without active consent version with HTTP 422; withdrawal endpoint and retention purge endpoint delete documents and scrub PII while preserving audit chain.
- **Implementation Path:** [`backend/app/core/consent.py, backend/app/api/v1/applications.py, backend/app/api/v1/admin.py`](../backend/app/core/consent.py)
- **Verification Test:** [`backend/tests/integration/test_consent_and_retention.py`](../backend/tests/integration/test_consent_and_retention.py)
- **Measurement / Benchmark:** `docs/threat_model.md`
- **Audit Evidence:** POST /api/v1/applications returns 422 for unaccepted consent or stale SHA-256 version; purge endpoint deletes raw S3/local files, masks PII, and confirms verify_chain remains valid.
- **Status:** **VERIFIED**
